title: GET /api/profile-audit
description: Admin only: history of the profile model with before/after, newest first ("Verlauf" of the device page and the profile editor). Query client_id and/or profile_id filter, limit 1–500 (default 100). Persistent in the hub (table profile_audit). The remote PIN never appears (remote_pin_set/profile_remote_pin_set carry only whether a PIN is set).

actor.description: Who made the change: HA user name of the admin, "integration", the brand name for expired adjustments, "Migration v9"; null = unknown.

before.description: State before (shape per action, e.g. {value, expires_at} for override_*, {profile_id} for profile_assigned, {own_area_id} for own_area_set, the profile for profile_updated); null = none.

after.description: State after, same shapes as before; null = none (deleted, expired).

note.description: Note of the adjustment, "bulk", "Migration v9" or null.
